:::{#sol-rank-product-full-rank-practice}

[Columns of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column), $(1, 0, 1)$ and $(0, 1, 1)$,
are [linearly independent](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-linearly-independent):
the first two entries of $c_1\,(1, 0, 1) + c_2\,(0, 1, 1)$ are $c_1$ and $c_2$.
So $\matr{A}$ has [full column rank](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-full-column-rank).
The second [column of](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-column) $\matr{B}$ is twice the first,
so $\rankf{\matr{B}} = 1$.
By part 1 of @cor-rank-product-full-rank,

$$
\rankf{\matr{A}\matr{B}} = \rankf{\matr{B}} = 1.
$$

:::
